tokyo_kaminarimon_sansada_sans.price_note: Six tempura dishes with prices from the shop’s own menu page; the page describes the contents of each but does not extend to rice bowls, sides or drinks, so this is the tempura board rather than the whole menu. Tabelog not consulted: it has served Cf-Mitigated: challenge (HTTP 403) to this egress since 2026-09-02. ⚠ THE ONE THING THIS SHOP SAYS THAT CHANGES A DIET ANSWER IS ABOUT THE OIL, NOT THE FLOUR: 「胡麻油で揚げる伝統を今に伝える」 — it fries in SESAME OIL, in the old Edo style. That matters twice over. For a coeliac it changes nothing at all: the batter is still wheat flour and the tentsuyu is still soy and dashi, so the whole board is closed. But SESAME is one of Japan’s designated allergens in its own right, and a shop that fries everything in sesame oil is a hazard for a sesame allergy that no dish name would reveal — worth recording because this dataset’s users travel with more than one restriction. ⚠ THERE IS NOTHING HERE FOR EITHER DIET. Every item is battered; 季節の野菜天ぷら at ¥1,940 is six seasonal vegetables and is vegetarian in filling and wheat in coating, which is the same near-miss the vegetable tempura at every other shop in this set produces. ⚠ ONE PRACTICAL NOTE: the 大かき揚 at ¥8,000 is offered but the shop warns 混雑時はお受け出来ない場合もございます — it may be refused at busy times.

The chain caveat 「一部店舗では取り扱いのないメニューがある場合や価格が異なる場合がございます」 applies, hence partial. This is a Jiro-style (二郎系) shop and the numbers matter: 小 is 250 g of noodle, ミニ 125 g, 大 375 g, and the chain warns its own 小 is about the size of an ordinary shop’s 大盛 and tells first-timers to order ミニ or 小. ⚠ NOTHING IN THIS SHOP IS GLUTEN-FREE AND THE FREE-TOPPING RITUAL DOES NOT CHANGE THAT. 極太麺 is thick wheat noodle, the tare is soy, and the pork is soy-braised; the 汁なし, つけ麺 and 冷やし中華 variants are the same noodle with more soy. The chain DOES publish an アレルギー表・産地情報 PDF at https://butayama.com/allergy/ and it IS a real allergen table, but it is a graphical scan whose Japanese product names and marks do not extract as text, so nothing below is drawn from it. ⚠ THE CALL SYSTEM IS THE ONE THING A VISITOR SHOULD PRE-LEARN, and the shop prints the exact quantities: garlic 抜き 0 g / 少し half a tablespoon / ニンニク one tablespoon / マシマシ two tablespoons; vegetables 少なめ 150 g / 標準 300 g / マシ 450 g / マシマシ 600 g; back fat 標準 / アブラ / アブラマシマシ; tare strength 標準 / カラメ / カラカラ. Calls are taken just before the bowl is handed over; 麺硬め must be said earlier, when the ticket is collected. ⚠ SEASONAL LINES: つけ麺 is sold 1 April to 30 September and 冷やし中華 1 June to 30 September only.

tokyo_niku_bistro_akari.price_note: ALMOST EMPTY ON PURPOSE, AND THE REASON IS WORTH RECORDING. 肉ビストロ灯 (西新宿7-16-3 第18フジビル 2F, Zekkocho group) does publish its full Food, Drink and Course menus — but only as three image-scan PDFs linked from its Menu page (20260217_Food_Menu.pdf, 20260217_Drink_Menu.pdf, course.pdf, all dated by the 2026.02.17 グランドメニューが新しくなりました news item). pdftotext returns one byte from each: they carry no text layer, and this machine has no pdftoppm to render the pages, so NOT ONE DISH NAME OR PRICE COULD BE READ. The single price the site states in HTML is the お通し at 660 yen (税込), recorded below because it is compulsory. What the site does describe in words, and which is worth knowing before booking: the kitchen serves 6-8 different 塊肉 (whole-block cuts) a day — beef, pork, lamb and gibier including venison and wild boar — seared over 備長炭 charcoal and served rare in the middle, alongside a locked wine cellar of roughly 100-150 bottles that guests walk into with a lantern. No allergen information is published anywhere. Anyone re-running this record needs either a PDF rasteriser or the shop’s own reservation line.

tokyo_hikiniku_to_come_shibuya.price_note: ⚠ THIS IS THE BEST ALLERGEN DISCLOSURE FOUND IN THIS WHOLE TICK AND IT DELIVERS THE OPPOSITE OF WHAT PEOPLE HOPE. 挽肉と米 publishes a real, machine-readable per-item allergen table at hikinikutocome.com/allergen covering all 29 Japanese labelled items, and it declares the HAMBURG ITSELF as containing 卵・牛乳・小麦・牛肉 — WHEAT IS IN THE PATTY. A shop whose entire menu is three charcoal-grilled minced-beef patties and a bowl of rice reads, to a coeliac, like it ought to be safe; it is not, and only the shop’s own table would have told you. The prices are the other half of the story: NO PRICE IS PUBLISHED ANYWHERE ON THE OFFICIAL SITE — not on the Shibuya page, not on the menu page, not in the FAQ — so the set below is unpriced, deliberately. ⚠ WHAT IS ACTUALLY SAFE HERE, BY THE SHOP’S OWN TABLE: the 味噌汁 (declares 牛乳・大豆, no wheat), the コッチョリ生キムチ (えび・ごま), the ポテサラ (卵・大豆・りんご・牛肉) and the three table spice blends (ごま only) — BUT read the miso soup line with care, because 麦味噌 is BARLEY and barley is NOT one of the 29 labelled items, so an allergen table CANNOT clear a miso soup of gluten. Everything soy-based is declared wheat: 挽肉のタレ, 食べる醤油 and 生醤油 all list 小麦. ⚠ ONE INCONSISTENCY WORTH KNOWING: the 楽しみ方 page says the set comes with 自家製ポン酢, but ポン酢 does not appear anywhere in the allergen table — ask which of the declared sauces it corresponds to. Format: the menu is deliberately ONE dish, three 90 g patties served one at a time onto rice with free rice refills, one free egg per person, and 鬼おろし grated daikon arriving with the second patty. Shibuya is at 渋谷区道玄坂2-28-1 椎津ビル3F, 11:00-15:00 and 17:00-21:00, closed Wednesdays, walk-in register via web only — no phone or SNS booking. The 八味唐辛子 in the table is marked 京都店のみ and is NOT available at Shibuya.

tokyo_curry_rice_specialist_et.price_note: NO PRICES ARE PUBLISHED on the shop’s own site, which was rebuilt on 2025-07-29 with an お薦めメニュー page that names the dishes and describes them but prints no figures at all — hence partial, and hence unpriced items. カリーライス専門店エチオピア 本店 is the Jimbocho original, founded 1988, owner-chef 鈴木堅司, and the site describes the style as インド風カリーライス. ⚠ THE ALLERGEN PDF EXISTS, DECLARES WHEAT, AND ITS GRID CANNOT BE READ. The shop links food-allergy.pdf and its header states in English that ALL MENU items are covered for «shrimp, wheat, eggs, dairy, cashew nut, beef, soybeans, chicken, banana, pork, yam, lamb, apple, gelatin, sesame». Its text layer is a simple one-character-shifted cipher and the English header decodes cleanly, but the Japanese product names and the per-item marks are CID glyphs that yield nothing, so WHICH dishes contain the wheat could not be established here. ⚠ THAT MATTERS BECAUSE THE SHOP’S OWN PROSE POINTS AT THE ANSWER: every description on the site is built around the ルー — 「ルーとビーフ、そしてライスの織り成す絶妙のバランス」, 「ルーとの相性がすこぶる良く」 — and a Japanese curry ルー is a WHEAT-FLOUR roux. The bean curries are described as サラサラタイプのルー (thin, not thickened), which is the one hint that they may be built differently, but the shop does not say so and it must not be assumed. Every curry is therefore recorded no. The bean curries are also flagged 辛さは3倍から — they START at heat level 3.

tokyo_shibuya_yokocho_hokkaido.price_note: PARTIAL BECAUSE THE OPERATOR PUBLISHES DISHES AND REFUSES TO PUBLISH PRICES, AND SAYS SO. 渋谷横丁 is a nineteen-unit food-and-entertainment strip inside RAYARD MIYASHITA PARK, and its official site gives each unit a block with a description, a phone number, opening hours and a MENU list of named dishes — under a standing caveat printed above every one of them: 「※仕入れ状況によって、メニューや価格が変更となる場合がございます」, menus and prices change with what comes in. No figure appears against any dish anywhere on the site. The twelve dishes below are the ones the operator lists for the HOKKAIDO 食市 unit specifically, not for the strip as a whole. TEL 03-6805-1257, 11:00 to 05:00 the following morning, except Sundays when it closes at 23:00. ⚠ TWO NAMES ON THIS LIST MEAN THE OPPOSITE OF WHAT THEY LOOK LIKE, AND THE OPERATOR FLAGS BOTH ITSELF. 室蘭焼鳥 is written with the characters for grilled CHICKEN and the site says plainly that in Muroran 「やきとり」 means PORK and onion — the strip's own summary line even reads 「鳥は使わないけど『室蘭焼き鳥』」, 'we don't use chicken, but it's Muroran yakitori'. And 北海道ザンギ is not plain fried chicken: the site says the local way is to eat it dipped in Worcester sauce with pepper floated on it, and WORCESTER SAUCE IS A WHEAT-AND-ANCHOVY PRODUCT, so the sauce is both a gluten fact and a fish fact that the karaage itself would not have told you. ⚠ THE REST IS A HOKKAIDO IZAKAYA BOARD AND THERE IS NOTHING VEGAN ON IT: seafood bowls, crab, sea urchin, squid, mutton-adjacent grills, pork, and a miso ramen. The one non-animal line, ソフトクリーム, is dairy.

tokyo_raishu_ken.price_note: THE WEBSITE THIS DATASET CARRIES IS NO LONGER THE SHOP'S — IT IS A PARKED DOMAIN, AND THAT IS THE FINDING. https://www.raisyuken.com/ returns a 4.8KB page whose entire body is the word "Redirecting..." plus an obfuscated script that POSTs to router.parklogic.com, a domain-monetisation service. Decoding the script's own base64 configuration confirms it: it declares domainFull "www.raisyuken.com" under tenant "seth", i.e. the domain has been picked up by a parking operator. There is no restaurant content at this address at all — no menu, no address block, no hours, no navigation. Re-fetching will not help; the record needs a NEW first-party URL before it can be researched, and until it has one it is not reachable work. The dataset's menu_url points at Tabelog, which this egress cannot reach (Cloudflare challenge since 2026-09-02). 来集軒 is recorded here as a 醤油ラーメン shop in Asakusa — soy-sauce ramen is wheat noodles in a soy tare, so the whole proposition is gluten, but no dish or price has been established.
